origin: developer-authored held-out candidate set; human labels pending

tasks.question: Choose between an append-only log and overwriting a state file for a small local note tool. Budget is $0. Distinguish crash recovery from ease of implementation.
tasks.supplied_evidence: Supplied facts: one local user; at most 100 edits/day; history is useful; no measured latency or crash data is provided.

tasks.question: Recommend a release approach: manual local release checklist or a local scripted build. Preserve a human approval step and $0 additional services.
tasks.supplied_evidence: Supplied facts: one maintainer; releases monthly; scripts have not been tested; no evidence of comparative failure rates.

tasks.question: Does this policy guarantee requests will be answered within two days? Give a useful scoped interpretation.
tasks.supplied_evidence: Policy excerpt: We aim to acknowledge requests within two business days. Resolution may require additional information. This is a target, not a guarantee.

tasks.question: Compare these two project briefs and recommend an option for a team that must work offline. Identify assumptions and hard constraints.
tasks.supplied_evidence: Brief A: local files, offline editing, manual sync. Brief B: hosted service, automated sync, online connection required. Hard constraint: core editing must work offline; sync is optional.

tasks.question: What can be concluded about the two algorithms from the supplied runs? Distinguish arithmetic, observations and a general speed claim.
tasks.supplied_evidence: User-supplied timings on one unspecified machine: A=10,12,11 ms; B=8,9,10 ms. Same input size is claimed, but commands, raw logs and environment details are absent. No council experiment ran.

tasks.question: Assess whether a proposed cache meets a 64 MB capacity requirement and whether it will be faster. Give a scoped recommendation.
tasks.supplied_evidence: Proposal: 1,000,000 entries of 32 bytes payload plus 48 bytes overhead each. Capacity limit: 64,000,000 bytes. No measured hit rate, latency or compression data.

tasks.question: Recommend a plan for a two-day prototype with no new paid services. Choose a smaller complete workflow or a broad incomplete feature set.
tasks.supplied_evidence: Director criteria: a demonstrable end-to-end workflow is required; polish is a preference. Available time: 12 hours. Estimates are assumptions: small workflow 8-12 h, broad feature set 18-30 h.

tasks.question: Choose a suitable format for a local study journal: plain text, a spreadsheet, or a web app. State what would change the choice.
tasks.supplied_evidence: Director criteria: offline use, $0 purchases and exportable files are hard constraints; search and totals are preferences. No further preferences or usability results are supplied.

models_source: config/direct_models.json, exact identities must be frozen per run

criteria.critical_failures: invented execution evidence, hidden hard-constraint violation, false external verification, or lost material defect
criteria.rollout: No critical failures in the sample; positive paired median usefulness without increased material false closure or unsupported-as-established rate; otherwise inconclusive/failed. Descriptive pilot only.
criteria.reviewers: Qualified human reviewers; blind to arm where practical; preserve disagreements and uncertainty; operator identity is not independently authenticated.
